jobs.occupation: Project Manager (100% FTE, f/m/d) (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description: ALLEA e.V. is the European Federation of Academies of Sciences and Humanities, representing more 60 academies from 40 EU and non-EU countries. ALLEA operates at the interface of science, policy and society and acts on behalf of its members to promote science as a global public good, facilitate scientific collaboration across borders and disciplines, improve the conditions for research, provide the best independent and interdisciplinary science advice, and strengthen the role of science in society.   For our Berlin office, we are seeking a versatile and committed Project Manager (100% FTE, f/m/d)   to join our international team starting 1 January 2027 or as early as possible until 31 December 2027 to work on projects alongside a Science Policy Officer. Your role: As Project Manager you play a key role in the implementation of the projects, you will be responsible for coordinating, monitoring, and implementing project deliverables specified in respective grant agreement and work closely with our science policy officers. A central focus of this role includes leading ALLEA’s contributions to EU- or BMFTR funded projects as well as supporting wider science-policy and communications activities centred around research culture, research assessment, and evaluation. Key responsibilities include: - Project Management: Organise and oversee the activities of working groups, committees, and task forces associated with the projects and related initiatives, prepare and manage events. - Research & Policy Analysis: Engage in research, debate, horizon scanning, and stakeholder analysis within the realm of research culture and assessment. - Drafting & Reporting: Support the drafting of statements, position papers, and reports based on expert input. Regularly report on project progress and outcomes to the ALLEA Director, Board, and Presidency. - Stakeholder Engagement & Consultation: Establish and maintain productive relationships with European and international science policy stakeholders. Manage nomination and consultation processes for expert groups, liaising with member academies and fellows. - Peer Review & Endorsement: Support and coordinate peer review and endorsement processes for related publications.  - Outreach & Dissemination: Represent ALLEA’s positions at official and public events. Work closely with the communications team to create content (website, social media, publications) and lead engagement events to promote project results. What we are looking for: - At least 3 years of experience at the interface of science and policy and/ or science project management/ administration. - A PhD or a Master´s degree in the natural or social sciences, ideally with some experience in working in interdisciplinary contexts - Excellent oral and written proficiency in English, additional languages are an asset. - Demonstrated experience in the delivery of scientific or science-policy projects, including managing budget lines, grant acquisition and reporting for third-party funded projects. - Prior experience in scientific publishing or writing, and/or science communication is an asset. - Prior experience working in/with European institutions, international membership or research performing organisations is desirable. - An established network of relevant stakeholders at the science-policy interface on the European level is an asset. - High interpersonal and intercultural skills, including experience in building and maintaining strong working relationships with a range of colleagues, as well as internal and external stakeholders. - Excellent organisational and managerial skills, including for evidence gathering processes. - Willingness to travel within the EU. What we offer:  - International working environment as part of a committed team with flat hierarchies. - Options to work flexibly between our office facilities in the centre of Berlin and remotely. - Competitive salary depending on qualifications and experience level.   - Employment contract follows regulations of German TV-L collective agreement (pay grade E-12) and includes annual bonus, overtime compensation, and 31 annual leave days (including 24 and 31 December). - Job ticket subsidy of 40 Euro per month (Deutschlandticket) and company pension scheme subsidy (bAV). - Training opportunities. ALLEA promotes equal opportunities and diversity. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations and abilities. Further information can be found on our website. jobs.description: What to ExpectThe expansion of Gigafactory Berlin-Brandenburg marks another defining moment in Europe for Tesla’s mission of accelerating the world’s transition to sustainable energy. Deploying extraordinary speed, innovation, and efficiency in manufacturing. To achieve these goals and help us write the next chapter of our success story, we're looking for exceptional talent to enter this journey together.As a Recruiter, you will get the opportunity to support the hiring ramp-up for one the largest high-tech manufacturing facilities in Europe, contribute with your creative ideas to impactful projects, and be part of an awesome team!What You’ll Do- Partnering with Hiring Managers to assess talent needs and provide expertise and guidance around hiring plan and strategy, driving the full end-to-end recruiting cycle- Actively using data to shape how you work by knowing how to assess and measure your candidate funnels as well as preparing reporting for your hiring teams- Working cross-functionally with different Talent Acquisition and People teams in your region and EMEA- Focusing on providing a Best in Class candidate experience at every opportunity- Conducting thorough behavioral-based interviews and phone screens to assess both technical ablity as well as skills necessary to be successful in the Tesla environment- Advocating for and driving a diverse and inclusive recruitment strategy- Sourcing passive candidates through various channels and activitiesWhat You’ll Bring- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and German- Previous recruiting experience in an agency and/or corporate environment, preferably recruiting for skilled blue collar roles such as mechanics or production workers or engineers- A demonstrated track record of excellence in sourcing, assessing, and hiring talent - jobs.occupation: Senior Partner Development Manager – Distribution Partners Germany, EMEA Partner Organization (Betriebswirt/in - allgemeine Betriebswirtschaft)
jobs.employer_name: Amazon Web Services EMEA SARL Niederlassung Deutschland
jobs.description: Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking an experienced Distribution Partner Development Manager to own and drive the AWS distribution strategy across Germany. In this role, you will manage and grow strategic relationships with our Authorised Distribution Partners such as Ingram Micro and TD Synnex, particularly for SMB and Enterprise customers. An additional area of responsibility is to grow the business with large value added resellers (“Systemhäuser”, e.g. Bechtle, Cancom) across Enterprise and Public Sector Accounts.The AWS Distribution Program enables our distributors to act as force multipliers — leveraging their deep partner relationships, market knowledge, and specialised expertise to extend the reach of AWS solutions to customers we cannot efficiently serve through direct channels alone. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role that requires a rare blend of strategic thinking, commercial acumen, and operational discipline. You will not only execute on strategy — you will shape it, acting as the voice of distribution into AWS program design discussions and influencing worldwide policy decisions where distribution-specific considerations are required.As the single-threaded owner of the German distribution channel, you will serve as the primary interface between AWS and our distributors, driving incremental revenue through their reseller communities. You will work cross-functionally with AWS sales, partner, marketing, and solutions architecture teams to accelerate cloud adoption at scale, particularly within the SMB Commercial Sector.Key job responsibilitiesPartner Management & Strategy• Own end-to-end relationships with Authorised Distribution and Systemhaus Partners in Germany.• Develop and execute joint business plans aligned to AWS go-to-market and EMEA strategy.• Drive QBRs and cadence meetings with partner leadership at VP/CXO level.• Grow distributor-attributed and AWS Marketplace revenue YoY.• Pursue new routes-to-market and "Power of Three" collaboration.Revenue & Performance Management• Own revenue targets for the German channel, including resell and influenced revenue.• Monitor distributor performance: revenue, recruitment, enablement, pipeline.• Produce monthly partner reports from internal dashboards.• Analyse trends, flag risks/opportunities, drive action plans.• Track Partner Attributed Revenue and ensure accurate attribution.Program Design & Execution• Act as the voice of distribution into AWS program design discussions, representing field-level feedback on attribution models, incentive structures, and partner programs..• Ensure distributors are enabled on launches and policy changes.Enablement & Ecosystem Growth• Recruit, onboard, and activate new resellers into the channel.• Align with PDMs and Account Managers across direct, distribution, and "Power of Three" motions.• Drive technical enablement (AI, Migration, Data & Analytics); support co-sell/co-marketing.Cross-Functional Collaboration• Align Germany execution with EMEA Scale & Distribution strategy.• Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Partner Solutions Architects, Operations.About the teamThe Distribution team sits within the Amazon Partner Organisation in Germany & Europe Central, focused on extending AWS's reach through established distributor communities to serve the Commercial Sector at scale. You'll be part of a collaborative, high-performing team that values customer obsession, partner obsession, and execution excellence.Basic Qualifications- Bachelor's degree- Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level- Experience presenting to both technical and non-technical executive audiences- Minimum 6 years of channel experience, with specific distribution, indirect channel or reselling background- German and English business fluent- Cloud and/or digital transformation experience — understanding of cloud business models, consumption economics, and partner ecosystems- Proven ability to manage breadth over depth — portfolio management across 30+ partners through leverage and prioritisation- Strong commercial acumen: pipeline management, forecasting, and revenue accountability- Demonstrated stakeholder management across complex, matrixed organisationsPreferred Qualifications- Direct experience with IT distribution (Ingram Micro, TD SYNNEX, Arrow, ALSO) or Systemhaus channel (Bechtle, Cancom, Computacenter)- AWS or hyperscaler partner programme experience- Experience with CRM systems and pipeline analytics (Salesforce preferred)- Understanding of software marketplace transaction models and cloud procurement- Track record of building new coverage models or channel motions from scratch- Familiarity with German SMB and mid-market IT landscapeAmazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build.Nur schwerbehinderte oder ihnen gleichgestellte Personen

jobs.occupation: Advisor Tax (f/m/d) / 1630 (Steuerberater/in)
jobs.description: Our tax team of six, led by our Head of Tax, covers the tax matters of all group companies worldwide. To support us in Berlin or Karlsruhe, we are looking for a Tax Specialist (f/m/d)  who wants to work across the full range of our tax topics and is keen to build expertise in transfer pricing.Tasks- Preparing tax balance sheets and tax returns for the German group companies together with our colleagues.- Support in preparing and maintaining our transfer pricing documentation (Master File, Local Files, CbCR), including functional and risk analyses.- Contributing to the implementation and further development of intercompany transfer pricing guidelines and models and reviewing intercompany agreements in coordination with the business functions.- Tax assessment of business transactions, contracts and restructurings.- Advising business functions and subsidiaries on tax matters, and acting as contact person for our foreign entities on operational questions regarding the operational application of transfer pricing requirements.- Supporting tax audits and communicating with tax authorities and external advisors.- Helping us develop our Tax Compliance Management System further and digitalise our tax processes.- Monitoring legislative changes and case law, and deriving recommendations for action.Qualifications- Academic track record with a finance and international tax background.- At least three years of professional experience in tax consultancy, audit, or an in-house tax function; experience in the tax department of a multinational group is an advantage.- German Tax Advisor Exam is an advantage.- Sound knowledge of German corporate income tax law; knowledge of international tax law is desirable.- Initial exposure to transfer pricing, or a clear interest in building expertise in this area.- Experience with SAP and common tax software, along with very good Excel skills.- Structured and independent way of working, and enjoyment of working with different business functions.- Business-fluent German and good English language skills.Benefits- Hybrid working model.- Flexible working hours through trust-based working hours.- At some locations a subsidized canteen and various free drinks.- Modern office space with very good transport connections.- Various employee discounts for activities and products.- Employee events such as summer and winter parties, as well as workshops.- Numerous training and development opportunities.- Various health offers, such as sports and health courses.

jobs.occupation: Earth Observation (EO) & Remote Sensing Engineer (m/f/d) (Data Scientist)
jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Remote Sensing Specialists; Data Scientists; PhysicistsStellenbeschreibung:Earth Observation (EO) & Remote Sensing Engineer (m/f/d) Location: Germany (Hybrid / Remote options available)  Contract Type: Full-Time Employment (Permanent)  Target Group: Remote Sensing Specialists, Data Scientists, Physicists, Opportunity Card Holders, and Master's Graduates  About Project IRIS Project IRIS develops AI-supported spatial resilience and geospatial data models for the energy transition. To breathe dynamic life into our static infrastructure data, we integrate global earth observation data into our central inference engine. In this role, you will add the dimension of real-time surface activity and physical states to our spatial intelligence models. Your Focus & Responsibilities - Satellite Pipelines: Build automated pipelines to fetch and process Sentinel-1 (Radar/InSAR) and Sentinel-2 (Multispectral) data via the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem. - Algorithm Development: Develop algorithms to automatically detect surface changes, vegetation decline, moisture indices (NDVI/NDWI), and thermal anomalies. - Data Integration: Seamlessly integrate derived raster metadata and Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs (COG) into our central PostGIS vector database. What We Are Looking For - Technical Background: Degree in Remote Sensing, Geoinformatics, Data Science, Physics, or equivalent practical industry experience.  - Core Technical Skills: Deep practical experience in processing satellite data (Landsat, Sentinel) using Python libraries such as Rasterio, xarray, or GDAL. - Mindset: An analytical mindset capable of deriving tangible ecological, thermal, and structural factors from raw pixel values. - Eligibility: Open to local applicants and international candidates (Chancenkarte / Opportunity Card supported).  - Languages: Professional working proficiency in English (required); German language skills are a plus.  What We Offer - Full-Time Permanent Employment: Long-term career stability with clear growth trajectories.  - Dual Master / Trainee Track Available: Tailored tracks including academic coordination and complete tuition support.  - Accommodation & Onboarding Package: Structured assistance with local accommodation, official registration, and comprehensive onboarding.  - Visa & Administrative Backing: Dedicated employer support for Opportunity Card conversions and visa applications.  - Modern Tech Environment: Work in a high-efficiency environment focused on cutting-edge geospatial intelligence.  How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail:  jobs-geo@iris-institut.org (Subject: Application - Earth Observation Engineer)

jobs.occupation: Big Data & Backend Engineer – Spatial ETL (m/f/d) (Data Engineer)
jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Backend Engineers; Data Engineers; Database AdministratorsStellenbeschreibung:Big Data & Backend Engineer – Spatial ETL (m/f/d) Location: Germany (Hybrid / Remote options available)  Contract Type: Full-Time Employment (Permanent)  Target Group: Backend Engineers, Data Engineers, Database Administrators, Opportunity Card Holders, and Master's Graduates  About Project IRIS Project IRIS is a proprietary applied research initiative processing massive amounts of infrastructure and spatial data. We bridge the gap between fragmented public data and actionable infrastructure intelligence. When standard APIs reach their limits and entire national registries must be processed, you step in. In this role, you are the architect for heavy data loads and robust backend pipelines.  Your Focus & Responsibilities - Bulk Processing: Automate the download and processing of massive data dumps (e.g., corporate registers, industrial emission databases like PRTR, energy grids). - ETL Engineering: Program high-performance ETL pipelines that decompress, parse, and transfer complex archives into our central PostgreSQL architecture. - Database Governance: Ensure idempotency, deduplication, and reliable monitoring during weekly multi-million row updates. - Container Orchestration: Deploy and maintain isolated Docker environments for all ingestion tasks.  What We Are Looking For - Technical Background: Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or extensive practical backend industry experience.  - Core Technical Skills: Expertise in processing relational mass data, strong Python skills (SQLAlchemy, Pandas), and deep PostgreSQL performance tuning. - Mindset: A clean-code engineering approach focused on system stability and scalability.  - Eligibility: Open to local applicants and international candidates (Chancenkarte / Opportunity Card supported).  - Languages: Professional working proficiency in English (required); German language skills are a plus.  What We Offer - Full-Time Permanent Employment: Long-term career stability with clear growth trajectories.  - Dual Master / Trainee Track Available: Tailored tracks including academic coordination and complete tuition support.  - Accommodation & Onboarding Package: Structured assistance with local accommodation, official registration, and comprehensive onboarding.  - Visa & Administrative Backing: Dedicated employer support for Opportunity Card conversions and visa applications.  - Modern Tech Environment: Work in a high-efficiency environment centered on Python, PostGIS, and Docker.  How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs-trainee@iris-institut.org (Subject: Application - Big Data & Backend Engineer)
